summary: Successfully tested RFQ Analysis and Quotation System. All 23 backend API tests pass (1 skipped). Frontend testing confirms QuotationComparison component displays vendors sorted by cost with Material, Machining, Additional, and Total cost columns. AI Analyze & Match functionality and vendor matching work correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: POST /api/rfq/analyze-and-match correctly detects process (machining/casting/forging) and matches vendors based on machine categories
detect_process_requirements() function uses keywords to identify casting, forging, machining, fabrication processes
evaluate_vendor_match() correctly excludes casting/forging vendors when raw material is provided by buyer
GET /api/rfq/:rfqId/vendors returns matched vendors with has_quoted status and quote_info
GET /api/rfq/:rfqId/quotations returns quotations with full cost breakdown (material_cost, machining_cost, additional_costs, total_cost)
POST /api/vendor/quotation validates material_cost required when vendor provides material
QuotationComparison component displays comparison table with Material, Machining, Additional, Total columns
Quotation comparison shows 'Best Price' badge for lowest total cost vendor
Sort functionality works (Total Cost Low to High)
Select button available for each quotation

success_rate.backend: 100% - 23/23 tests passed (1 skipped - vendor already quoted)

seed_data_creation: Test RFQ rfq_932de773568a has 2 quotations: Simpson Munro (₹1,500 total) and Test Quotation Vendor (₹27,000 total with material ₹15,000, machining ₹8,500, additional ₹3,500)

Frontend QuotationComparison component shows comparison table with sorting. Test RFQ rfq_932de773568a has 2 quotes for testing.
